You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there. You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls. AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results. Your Mission Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured. 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration. Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build. Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work. Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated. AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it. Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest. Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense. Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously. Your Profile 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users. AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products. Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture. Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments. Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple. Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment. Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters. Nice to Have Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field. Experience in fintech or another regulated industry. Early-stage startup background. Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering. Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics. Why Join Vivid? We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed. AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it. Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. Fully paid vacation and sick leave. Sports compensation. Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. Compensation range Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria. About Vivid At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights. Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality. Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us. raw.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance, and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Support team as the direct manager of a group of Support Engineers. While the function operates globally, with part of the team in Paris and the rest in New York, this specific role is based in Paris.

You will report to Matthieu, Global Head of Scale CS, and your manager, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also partner closely with Support Operations, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and IT. You will also be part of the global Go-To-Market community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience.

This is a player-coach role. Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations, supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day.

We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer: accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing.

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers:

  • Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback

  • Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans

  • Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing

  • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring

  • Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management

Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases:

  • Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through

  • Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk

  • Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success)

  • Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support

Quality, Process, & Performance

Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo:

  • Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions

  • Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results

  • Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers

  • Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action

  • Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations

Cross-functional Collaboration

Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues

  • Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle

  • Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Time to Resolution (TTR)

  • Ticket-to-active-user ratio

  • Team engagement and development


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment

  • Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team

  • Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance

  • Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills

  • Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket

  • Fluent in French & English mandatory

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams

  • A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience directly managing a team of five or more people

  • Experience supporting Enterprise customers

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments

  • Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform

  • Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations

  • Experience supporting distributed or international teams

  • Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support.

  3. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

At Quandela, we're moving from an R&D-driven organization toward a structured, scalable industrial operation. We're looking for a builder as much as a manager to create our end-to-end supply chain, from demand to customer delivery. Your first major challenge: build our S&OP process from the ground up. You'll move easily between strategy and execution, from running an S&OP review and an 18-month capacity outlook to solving a critical component shortage or securing an urgent customer shipment. 

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Build the S&OP process from scratch: define governance, meeting cadence, roles, inputs and KPIs, then progressively mature it as the company scales 
  • Lead monthly cross-functional S&OP reviews with Sales, Operations, Production, R&D, Purchasing, Finance and Management, and establish a single shared view of demand, supply and customer commitments
  • Consolidate demand from customer orders, weighted commercial forecasts, internal R&D needs, qualification activities and strategic programs into a rolling forecast
  • Build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, with planning horizons adapted to our long manufacturing and supply lead times
  • Translate demand into capacity, resource, material and supplier requirements, identify gaps and develop scenarios to support management decisions on priorities and commitments
  • Turn the production plan into executable schedules, monitor WIP and progress, and coordinate recovery plans when delays or shortages occur
  • Structure purchasing and MRP processes, define sourcing strategies based on lead time, criticality, supply risk, cost and MOQ, and track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness)
  • Define inventory principles and safety-stock strategies for critical components, while managing excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock
  • Organize inbound, internal and outbound logistics, including the transport of fragile, sensitive and high-value technological products
  • Manage customs and international trade: import/export documentation, classification, country of origin, Incoterms and compliance, in coordination with forwarders and brokers
  • Contribute to the selection and deployment of ERP/MRP and planning tools, reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and build clear supply chain dashboards
  • Define and track key KPIs (forecast accuracy, plan adherence, supplier and customer OTD/OTIF, inventory turns, shortages, lead times) and drive continuous improvement

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in planning, supply chain or industrial operations
  • Proven experience implementing or running an S&OP process 
  • APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP)
  • Strong command of demand and production planning, scheduling, MRP, purchasing, inventory management and logistics 
  • Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to turn complex data into clear priorities and decisions
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills
  • Thrives in a fast-changing, growing organization
  • Fluent French and English 

 Nice to have 

  • Experience in semiconductor, photonics, electronics or other high-tech manufacturing
  • Foundries, outsourced manufacturing and long-lead-time, critical-component supply chains
  • International suppliers and customers, customs and international logistics
  • ERP implementation or supply chain digitalization; advanced Excel or Power BI 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At the interface between Process Engineering and Production, you'll turn qualified processes into simple, robust and practical production standards, making manufacturing easier to execute, easier to control, more repeatable and more efficient. 

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Translate qualified processes into clear, executable production methods and define the optimal sequence of manufacturing operations 
  • Create and maintain manufacturing routings, Work Instructions, SOPs, checklists, inspection points and standard times, ensuring they reflect the approved process 
  • Define the resources required for each operation (equipment, tooling, materials, operator skills, inspection) and ensure consistency between BOM, routings, instructions and production data 
  • Support the setup and maintenance of manufacturing master data in ERP/MES systems 
  • Validate methods directly on the shop floor with operators, collect their feedback and integrate improvements into standards 
  • Train operators on new or modified methods and deploy standardized work and visual standards 
  • Analyze production flows to reduce non-value-added activities, waiting time, handling, excessive WIP and rework, and improve workstation organization, ergonomics and layout 
  • Measure and analyze machine, operator, setup and inspection times, compare actual vs. standard times, and provide reliable data for capacity planning, costing, workforce planning and investment decisions 
  • Identify, validate and document tooling and support workstation design 
  • Provide hands-on production support, investigate recurring issues related to methods, tooling or documentation, and implement practical corrective actions 
  • Support new product introduction and ramp-up, and manage the production impact of process, product or equipment changes 
  • Drive continuous improvement (5S, VSM, PDCA, 5 Why, root cause analysis) and track KPIs such as cycle time, FPY, scrap, productivity and OEE

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or Master's in Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical or Production Engineering, or a related field 
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in manufacturing methods, production engineering or industrial engineering
  • Proven experience creating Work Instructions, manufacturing routings and standard times 
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing flows and production operations
  • Analytical, data-driven mindset with strong problem-solving skills 
  • Pragmatic approach and ability to work directly with operators and technical teams
  • Comfortable in a fast-evolving industrial environment 
  • Fluent French and English 

 Nice to have 

  • Experience in semiconductor, photonics, electronics or high-tech manufacturing, cleanroom or precision assembly
  • Data tools such as Excel, Power BI or Python 

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)

raw.title: Industrialization & Manufacturing System Engineer
raw.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

At Quandela, we're scaling up the manufacturing of our semiconductor, photonic and quantum products, moving from advanced R&D and low-volume production toward structured, scalable industrial operations. We're looking for a hands-on, cross-functional engineer who combines manufacturing expertise, project leadership and digital transformation skills. You'll build a coherent, traceable industrial framework across Front-End and Back-End operations, and make sure our ERP/MES deployment is driven by real manufacturing needs, not by the IT systems themselves.  

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects across Front-End (semiconductor and photonic wafer/device manufacturing) and Back-End (packaging, optical, cryogenic, electronic, mechanical and system integration) 
  • Structure projects with clear milestones, deliverables, responsibilities, risks and action plans, coordinating R&D, Engineering, Production, Quality, Methods, Supply Chain and IT 
  • Manage the transfer of new products and processes from R&D to qualified production: assess manufacturing maturity, define industrialization plans and production-release criteria, and support pilot runs and ramp-up 
  • Act as the Manufacturing lead for ERP and MES deployment, defining business requirements and workflows from a production perspective 
  • Specify BOM/mBOM, routings, work centers, standard times, production orders and WIP management in the ERP 
  • Define MES requirements for electronic travelers, Work Instructions, traceability, process and equipment data, test results, non-conformances and rework, and support configuration, UAT, key users and go-live 
  • Ensure end-to-end consistency from PLM to ERP, MES and production equipment, so that digital tools serve manufacturing processes rather than dictate them 
  • Lead PFMEA on critical processes, turn risks into Control Plans, support process and equipment qualification, and run Manufacturing Readiness Reviews before production release 
  • Contribute to DFMEA with R&D to make sure manufacturability is built in from the design stage 
  • Define end-to-end manufacturing flows, traceability and product genealogy requirements, and structure manufacturing change management 
  • Identify industrialization gaps and bottlenecks, support capacity and equipment investment decisions, and ensure solutions are compatible with future volumes and automation 

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or Master's in Industrial, Manufacturing, Semiconductor or Systems Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering or manufacturing systems
  • Hands-on experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, qualification and manufacturing readiness
  • Strong cross-functional project management, including leading teams without direct authority
  • Solid understanding of ERP manufacturing processes and MES principles
  • Good command of manufacturing flows, BOM/mBOM, routings, traceability and production data
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills
  • Fluent French and English 

Nice to have 

  • Experience in semiconductor, photonic or high-tech manufacturing (cleanroom, wafer fab, Back-End integration) 
  • APQP, NPI or DfM/DfA methodologies 
  • Experience scaling low-volume, high-complexity production 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS   Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).   Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).     VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact. VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL  Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes. About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale.

When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner.   • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Initial conversation with Elena.

  2. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager.

  3. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA.

  4. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric.

  5. Strategic interview with Raph.

raw.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We’ve processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We’re growing 10% week over week. And we’re still early.

We’re looking for a mobile frontend engineer who treats the app as a craft, not a checklist. You care about the half-pixel, the spring curve on a transition, the way a screen feels in the hand, and you can build it. You own the mobile experience end-to-end in our monorepo, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around you.

You won’t spend your days writing boilerplate. You’ll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

What we’re looking for: Mobile frontend, design engineering & world-class craft

A confirmed mobile engineer (8+ years) with exceptional craft and a real sensibility for design. You live in Expo and React Native, you care deeply about how the product feels, and you don’t wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful. You have also experience building native experience. You think in interactions, motion, and detail.

You’ll own what members touch every day: onboarding, the core app surfaces, the moments that turn a first-time visitor into someone who trusts us with their health. Your work has to be delightful and reliable on real devices, for people who decide in minutes whether to trust us.

 
 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

  • You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

 

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · React Native · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

description: <p>As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.</p> <p>Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.</li> <li>Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.</li> <li>Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance title: Senior Regional Account Manager Schweiz (m/w/d) Westschweiz Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis
description: Über uns Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland. Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden. Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet. Deine Rolle Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld? FormMed steht für hochwertige Mikronährstofflösungen, wissenschaftliche Qualität und das gemeinsame Ziel, Gesundheit nachhaltig zu verbessern. In einem respektvollen, lernbereiten Umfeld arbeiten wir täglich daran, medizinische Expertise zugänglich zu machen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen. Als Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) verantwortest du den strategischen und nachhaltigen Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebiets in der Westschweiz mit den Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und gewinnst neue Partner im Gesundheitswesen. Du repräsentierst FormMed als kompetenten und verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte Vertriebsstärke mit Beratungskompetenz und einem echten Verständnis für die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden. Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt. Wenn du Vertrieb mit Purpose verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und einen Markt nachhaltig entwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet in der Westschweiz und entwickelst dieses nachhaltig weiter. Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du gewinnst neue FormMed-Therapeut und baust unser Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen gezielt aus. Du bringst dein bestehendes Netzwerk aktiv in die Zusammenarbeit mit FormMed ein und entwickelst neue Kontakte zu langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen. Du betreust bestehende Kund systematisch weiter und entwickelst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften zu loyalen Key Accounts. Du übernimmst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Gebiet und steuerst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent anhand relevanter KPIs. Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung. Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich. Du konzipierst und begleitest individuelle Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kund passende Lösungen. Du nutzt moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie Microsoft Dynamics CRM, digitale Vertriebstools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen, um deine Aktivitäten effizient zu planen und erfolgreich umzusetzen. Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen in der Westschweiz, leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab und setzt diese eigenverantwortlich um. Du identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für deren Erschließung. Du repräsentierst FormMed auf Fachveranstaltungen, Kongressen und relevanten Netzwerkveranstaltungen und stärkst damit unsere Präsenz im Schweizer Gesundheitsmarkt. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Kundenaufbau in deinem Vertriebsgebiet. Dein Profil Du verfügst über mehrjährige, nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Umfeld. Besonders willkommen sind Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mikronährstoffe, Diagnostik, Arzneimittel, Nahrungsergänzung oder vergleichbaren Gesundheitsprodukten. Du verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und zu Ärzten, Therapeuten, Apotheken oder weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen. Du hast Freude daran, dein Netzwerk aktiv für den Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbeziehungen einzusetzen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln. Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, medizinischen oder gesundheitlichen Bereich ist von Vorteil. Du denkst unternehmerisch, strategisch und ergebnisorientiert und hast Freude daran, dein Vertriebsgebiet eigenverantwortlich aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Vertriebskennzahlen, KPIs und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics, sowie MS Office und modernen digitalen Vertriebstools. Du überzeugst durch ein professionelles Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie und kannst medizinische und vertriebliche Themen verständlich und auf Augenhöhe vermitteln. Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen. Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind insbesondere für die Betreuung der Regionen Bern und Wallis von Vorteil. Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit. Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs. Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit. Warum wir? Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung Faire Arbeitszeiten & 25 Tage Urlaub – weil Work-Life-Balance für uns kein Buzzword ist Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen – z. B. auf unsere Präparate Weiterentwicklung garantiert – fachlich wie persönlich, in internen Schulungen und externen Coachings Ein Team, das dich trägt – regelmäßige Teamevents und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander inklusive Wo soll ich mich melden? Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das Wissenschaft und Wirkung verbindet – mit Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und einem Arbeitsplatz, der inspiriert. Du möchtest mehr über FormMed und die Rahmenbedingungen erfahren? Dann ist Deine Ansprechpartnerin Tanja Seidemann ( +49 160 / 94 16 18 07 ) aus dem People Team. description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.   Summary of Position: Reporting to the VP, Finance EMEA, the Associate Director/ Director, FP&A will support Scholar Rock’s EMEA organization. The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of planning and delivering against financial objectives in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. In this role, they will serve as a strategic partner in framing, evaluating, and driving decisions to maximize value creation. Success will require clear communication, strong organization, and a collaborative mindset. This position offers an opportunity to help build a critical cross-functional capability within a growing, evolving, multi-product candidate biotechnology company. Position Responsibilities Serve as the primary finance partner for the EMEA scope across revenue and OPEX planning. Support FP&A activities including budgeting and forecasting, long-range planning, scenario modeling, and financial analysis for strategic initiatives. Build and maintain patient and revenue models, ensuring appropriate underlying assumptions for direct and partner markets. Partner with EMEA Accounting on month-end and quarter-end close activities, quarterly schedules, procure-to-pay processes, and support for external reporting and audit inquiries. Deliver timely monthly budget-to-actual analyses, including variance analysis and management reporting. Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes to increase efficiency while maintaining flexibility to meet evolving business needs. Develop and deliver training and change-management support to drive adoption of new FP&A tools, systems, and ways of working across the organization. Support ad hoc strategic initiatives as business needs arise, including business development analyses, partner support, portfolio prioritization, and financing strategies. Candidate Requirements Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of progressive finance experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. Advanced degree in science and/or business preferred. Experience partnering with Commercial and/or Medical teams in a cross-functional environment. Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. Strong partnering and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to conduct complex analyses to support key decisions. Solid understanding of fundamental accounting principles. Understanding of the drug development process from early research through product launch. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Experience with Adaptive Insights and/or SAP is an asset. Fluency in English is required. Additional European languages are an asset. Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.

You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.

Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.

What you'll do

  • Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

  • Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

  • Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

  • Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

  • Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

  • Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

  • Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with recent experience owning enterprise or B2B product

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Experience shipping enterprise capabilities such as admin, permissions, billing, or security, and driving adoption across large customer accounts

  • Deep familiarity with how creative, marketing, and media teams work, and a habit of bringing customer insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Experience working directly with sales and customers and turning a high volume of requests into a clear, prioritized roadmap

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to mock up concepts and workflows yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs

  • Strong product judgment and a clear point of view on what to build and why

  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long alignment cycles

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams. Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction. Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation. Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks. title: Head of Hardware
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.   • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

raw.title: Solution Engineer 100% (a)
raw.description:
Über die Stelle

Als Solution Engineer bei gateB übersetzt du komplexe Kundenanforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du verbindest Beratung, Technologie und Umsetzung und begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen. 

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Projekten. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über erste Prototypen und Pilotlösungen bis zur produktiven Einführung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Consultants, Entwicklungsteams und Technologiepartnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen termingerecht, qualitativ hochwertig und mit erkennbarem Kundennutzen umgesetzt werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Kundenanforderungen sowie Erarbeitung von Systemkonzepten und Lösungsdesigns im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Projektteams
  • Konzeption von Workflows, Customer Journeys, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen sowie Erstellung umsetzbarer Briefings für Entwicklung und Implementation
  • Technische Konzeption, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Partnertechnologien wie BSI und Salesforce sowie von gateB-eigenen Lösungen
  • Konfiguration und Implementierung von Cloud- und Enterprise-Lösungen einschliesslich Reports, Systemmasken, Daten- und Metadatenmodellen, Benutzerverwaltungen und Geschäftslogiken
  • Erstellung von Proof-of-Concepts und Minimum Viable Products, Unterstützung bei Aufwandsschätzungen sowie Begleitung von Daten-, Content- und Systemmigrationen und Integrationen
  • Übernahme der technischen Verantwortung und der Funktion als primäre technische Ansprechperson in Implementierungsprojekten sowie Sicherstellung von Zeit, Budget, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Koordination interner Entwicklungsteams sowie von Projektmitarbeitenden bei Partnern und Kunden; Sicherstellung von Testing, Qualitätssicherung, technischer Dokumentation, Schulungen und System-Roll-outs
  • Proaktive Ressourcenplanung, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Engpässen und kostenbewusste Beratung in der Umsetzung
  • Unterstützung des Sales-Prozesses durch RFIs, RFPs und Sales-Demos sowie Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Technologien und Partnerlösungen im Hinblick auf Machbarkeit und Kundennutzen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung deines Know-hows, aktiver Wissenstransfer ins Team und zu unseren Kunden sowie Mitgestaltung von Software-Partnerschaften im Bereich AI und Enterprise Software


Dein Profil

  • Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang; alternativ eine technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementation und Konfiguration von Enterprise-Software-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- oder Content-Plattformen – idealerweise auf Dienstleisterseite
  • Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Verständnis für die Anwendung von AI-Technologien und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kundenanforderungen, Systemdesign, Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen und Qualitätssicherung sowie Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, technischer Dokumentation und interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
  • Beratungs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit tiefem technischem Verständnis, hoher technischer Affinität und Begeisterung für AI
  • Kundenorientierter, eigeninitiativ handelnder und lernfreudiger Umsetzer mit pragmatischer Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Kommunikationsstark, zugänglich und souverän im Auftreten – mit der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen bei technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern aufzubauen
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verbindlichkeit in Koordination, Priorisierung und Umsetzung
  • Flexibel, reisefreudig und offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte bei nationalen und internationalen Topkunden mit technisch hochstehenden Systemen
  • Möglichkeit, AI, digitale Transformation und Customer Experience bei Kunden wirksam zu verbinden
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Freiheit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gateB aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und interkultureller Austausch
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
  • 29 Tage Ferien sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile und Vergünstigungen – weil uns Erholung, Work-Life-Balance und dein Wohl am Herzen liegen


Deine Bewerbung

Du möchtest technische Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern gemeinsam mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams auch wirkungsvoll umsetzen?
